blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag on Thursday challenged Vice President Sara Duterte to file a case against him if her camp believes he is acting improperly amid the bureau’s investigation into allegations involving her. Matibag was responding to a statement from the vice president’s camp describing him as “evidently politically biased” against her. At a news conference on Thursday, Matibag was asked to elaborate on his earlier statement in a radio interview that those who believe he was biased or had done something wrong should file a case against him. “If they think they have […]...
